title: AgentRxiv: Towards Collaborative Autonomous Research
focus_en: Agent laboratories retrieve and publish research reports through shared memory, building on earlier reasoning and prompting experiments across research runs.
focus_zh: 科研智能体通过共享报告库检索和发布研究结果，在多轮研究中复用先前的推理与提示方法实验。
boundary_en: Evidence concerns cumulative progress on a specified benchmark objective; report reuse does not establish learned scientific taste or general cross-domain research strategy.
boundary_zh: 证据针对给定基准目标上的累积进展；复用报告不等于已经学会科研品味或通用跨领域科研策略。

title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery
focus_en: An evolution manager turns completed research traces into lasting idea and experiment memories. Researcher and engineer agents retrieve them for later tasks.
focus_zh: 演化管理智能体将已完成的研究轨迹转为持久的构思与实验记忆，供研究和工程智能体在后续任务中检索。
boundary_en: Adaptation comes from reusing stored strategies, not training the base model. Idea ratings and execution results do not establish general judgment of scientific importance.
boundary_zh: 适应依靠复用已保存的策略，不是训练基础模型。构思评分与执行结果不能证明对科学重要性的通用判断力。

title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
focus_en: Git records a shared graph of hypotheses, results, and verifications so research agents in separate sessions can reuse and extend collective work.
focus_zh: 用 Git 保存假设、结果与核验组成的共享图，使不同会话中的科研智能体能够复用和延续集体研究。
boundary_en: The weight-transfer case study documents reuse and verification; the paper says a matched comparison is needed to establish discovery gains per compute. Shared state is not model training.
boundary_zh: 权重迁移案例展示了复用与核验；论文指出仍需匹配对照才能确定单位算力的发现收益。共享状态不等于模型训练。

title: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning
focus_en: Uses comparative critique and execution feedback to improve reusable hypothesis-generation and testing skills. Tests those skills on held-out tasks without fine-tuning the base model.
focus_zh: 用比较式批评和执行反馈改进可复用的假设生成与检验技能，再在留出任务上测试；无需微调基础模型。
boundary_en: The test-pass metric rewards successful execution and p < 0.05 for reference hypotheses; this alone establishes neither false-positive control nor scientific importance. Adaptation does not update backbone weights.
boundary_zh: 检验通过指标要求参考假设的执行成功且 p < 0.05；这本身不能确立假阳性控制或科学重要性，适应过程也不更新基础模型参数。

title: CycleResearcher: Improving Automated Research via Automated Review
focus_en: Uses iterative preference training with a research-generation policy and an automated reviewer to improve research planning and manuscript generation.
focus_zh: 以研究生成策略模型和自动审稿模型进行迭代偏好训练，改进研究规划与论文文本生成。
boundary_en: Main results measure generated manuscripts and review scores. The model generates experimental results without running the experiments. An appendix adds an external executor, but execution is outside the core method.
boundary_zh: 主要结果评价生成稿件和审稿分数；其中实验结果由模型生成，实验并未实际运行。附录接入了外部执行器，但执行不属于核心方法。

title: Dolphin: Moving Towards Closed-loop Auto-research through Thinking, Practice, and Feedback
focus_en: Connects idea generation, code implementation, and experimental analysis in a loop that feeds previous results into the next research iteration.
focus_zh: 连接构思生成、代码实现与实验分析，把上一轮结果反馈给下一轮研究。
boundary_en: Feedback improves search within a supplied topic; it does not by itself demonstrate cross-task learning of research strategies, model-weight updates, or learned scientific taste.
boundary_zh: 反馈用于改进给定主题内的搜索；本身不能证明跨任务科研策略学习、模型参数更新或科研品味学习。

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
focus_en: Stores verbal reflections on task feedback in episodic memory to guide subsequent trials without updating model weights.
focus_zh: 将任务反馈转化为语言反思并存入情景记忆，以指导后续尝试，无需更新模型参数。
boundary_en: Evaluated on decision-making, coding, and reasoning tasks. It supports inference-time adaptation but is not direct evidence of scientific discovery or learned research taste.
boundary_zh: 评价覆盖决策、编程与推理任务，支持推理时适应；这些结果不能直接证明科学发现或科研品味学习。

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
focus_en: A meta-agent searches over agent programs using an archive of prior designs and evaluations, with transfer tests across tasks and foundation models.
focus_zh: 元智能体利用既有设计与评估档案搜索智能体程序，并开展跨任务和基础模型的迁移测试。
boundary_en: A foundation for improving agent workflows against specified task objectives; benchmark transfer does not establish the ability to choose important scientific questions.
boundary_zh: 属于针对给定任务目标改进智能体工作流的基础方法；基准迁移不能证明其能选择重要的科学问题。

title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
focus_en: Maintains an evolving archive of coding agents that modify their own code and assess resulting variants through empirical coding benchmarks.
focus_zh: 维护不断演化的编程智能体档案，让智能体修改自身代码，并通过编程基准评估产生的新版本。
boundary_en: Demonstrates agent self-improvement in coding. Benchmark gains are not a formal guarantee that self-modification helps, or evidence of scientific taste.
boundary_zh: 在编程任务中展示智能体自我改进。基准提升不构成自我修改有益性的形式化保证，也不是科研品味的证据。
